archival_memory.patient_medical_history_2024_q3:
Fasting glucose: 135 mg/dL; A1C: 6.9%; Morning glucose: 125–130 mg/dL. Action: Increase fiber, reduce refined carbs, walk 10–15 min post-meal.

Cholesterol: Total 195 mg/dL; LDL 130 mg/dL(target <100); HDL 58 mg/dL(good); Triglycerides 140 mg/dL. Action: Eat avocados, nuts, fatty fish; cut saturated fats.

BP: 138/85 mmHg(target <130/80). Action: Reduce sodium, drink 8–10 glasses water, manage stress, monitor daily.

Vitamin D: 22 ng/mL(deficient; target 30–50). Action: Take 2,000 IU daily; retest in 3–4 months; 10–15 min sun exposure 2–3x/week.

Thyroid: TSH 2.1 mIU/L(normal); T4 1.2 ng/dL(stable). Action: Continue levothyroxine; take morning, empty stomach, 30–60 min before food; check every 6–12 months.

Bone density: Spine T-score: -1.8 (osteopenia); Hip T-score: -1.5 (borderline). Action: Increase strength training(2x/week); boost calcium and vitamin D intake; take calcium + vitamin K2 supplement; consume dairy and leafy greens daily.

Liver & kidney: ALT: 42 U/L(elevated; normal <35 U/L); Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL(normal range: 0.6–1.2 mg/dL). Action: Monitor ALT closely; review recent medication changes; no kidney concerns. Follow up with doctor to assess if adjustment is needed.

Inflammatory markers: CRP: 3.2 mg/L(slightly elevated; ideal <3.0 mg/L); ESR: 18 mm/hr(normal; 0–20 mm/hr). Action: Mild inflammation likely linked to osteoarthritis; focus on anti-inflammatory lifestyle: increase fiber, omega-3s, physical activity; reduce processed foods, sugar, and excess salt; maintain consistent movement to reduce joint stress.
